subject: Is it possible to call a C++ program within a ShinyApp

messages.author: e62463df9f851b4c
messages.subject: Is it possible to call a C++ program within a ShinyApp
parts:
I have developed a ShinyApp that is build around a C++ program. In short, what the app does is 

- providing a nice interface to setup the parameters for the C++ app
- run the C++ compiled code using the system(...) command
- display the output of the C++ code using ggplot2

The C++ compiled code is stored into the www folder. 

I was wondering if such app would run on shinyapps.io, given that is has to run the C++ code.

messages.author: e62463df9f851b4c
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to call a C++ program within a ShinyApp
parts:
I tried to upload the app to the shinyapp.io website, using a free licence, but I got this error when the app is supposed to launch the c++ bit:

sh: 1: ./a.out: Permission denied

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to call a C++ program within a ShinyApp
parts:
shinyapps.io runs on Ubuntu 14.04.
You will need to compile for that architecture, and you will need to set the file permissions, e.g. chmod u+x ./a.out

messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to call a C++ program within a ShinyApp
parts:
ANSWER: 

As the log suggested, it was indeed a permission issue. It seems that, during the upload to the server, the a.out file permission changed . So the solutio was to add the line :

system("chmod 777 a.out") 

right before the line 

system("./a.out")

Now it works fine
